title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflows were expensive and slow to iterate on due to large matrices and duplicated setup steps. This PR splits the previous all-in-one pipeline into focused workflows (lint, test, release), standardizes cache keys, and reduces unnecessary matrix combinations. It also upgrades several GitHub Actions and consolidates reusable steps into actions/ci-common.yaml to improve maintainability. Changes include: - split lint/test/release into separate workflows with path filtering - consolidate common setup into .github/actions/ci-common.yaml - improve cache keys to include OS/node-version/deps-sha and reduce cache miss storm by limiting parallel restores - reduce test matrix for long-running E2E jobs and add stage-level concurrency/timeouts - upgrade actions/setup-node and actions/cache to latest major versions and bump node versions used by the SDK packages - small hygiene: remove deprecated scripts/ci/ci-matrix.sh and update docs/ci.md Notes: this is primarily a repo-hygiene and cost/perf optimization; no runtime product code changes expected. Linked Linear items and acceptance criteria are in the linked_linear field.
